verdict.rationale: An agent can reach audience data through the official MCP server (read/write contacts and mailing lists) and the API, which manages campaigns and workflows; the workflow API exposes workflow graphs from code. Nothing shows campaign performance metrics (opens, clicks, conversions, revenue attribution) are available through the API, MCP or CLI. Attribution reporting appears only as a product-site claim, so the 'report on what's working' core is unsupported. Missing for 10: API/MCP access to campaign and automation results or analytics, explicit read/list endpoints for live automations and campaigns, hands-on corroboration of an agent assembling a program-wide report.
